object_description: square compact five-storey volume with recessed ground floor
design_condition: The compact volume is precisely positioned along the surrounding building lines, set back from the nearby high-rise, and uses an introverted courtyard while maintaining a deliberate relationship to the street and site boundaries.

positive.statement: The project fits the existing situation in terms of urban planning and volume.

position.rationale: Square compact volume and recessed base are visible; contextual fit is anchored to the overall building.

positive.statement: The homely common-room design and interior structuring result in good interior quality and an identity-creating character.

position.rationale: Central placement reflects the courtyard-centered organization while interior rooms remain indistinguishable.

positive.statement: The arrangement of administration and large classrooms on the first floor, with further classrooms above, is practical and functional.

position.target: administration and large classrooms on the first floor
position.rationale: First-floor program is approximated in the lower elevated band above the recessed ground floor.

positive.statement: The core-supported slab structure allows the required flexibility in the school and administrative areas.

position.rationale: Core-supported structure is approximated at the central vertical organization.

positive.statement: Delivery and access to the bicycle cellar via the eastern courtyard work well.

position.target: eastern courtyard delivery and bicycle-cellar access
position.rationale: Eastern courtyard edge and low-level access are localized from the top and east elevation.

negative.statement: The inner courtyard is totally introverted and has no references to the outside via the façade.

position.rationale: The courtyard-centered void is identifiable near the middle of the square footprint.

negative.statement: Natural lighting on the lower floors is restricted by the narrowing terraces.

position.rationale: Recessed lower bands and terrace setbacks are visible around the building perimeter.

negative.statement: Locating the cafeteria, media library, and activity room on the attic floor creates long access routes to public-intensive uses.

position.target: attic-floor cafeteria, media library, and activity room
position.rationale: Attic-floor uses are anchored to the clearly visible upper parapeted volume.

negative.statement: The basement laboratories' natural lighting may be impaired by the future hospital building's height development.

position.rationale: Basement laboratories are approximated at a low rear-side location beneath the building.

negative.statement: Some façade and roof constructions and interior glazing are complex, placing construction costs in the upper segment.

position.target: façade and roof constructions and interior glazing
position.rationale: Parapeted roof, façade bands, and glazed exterior surfaces are visible in plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The introverted building and attic-floor arrangement only partially meet the school's objectives.

position.rationale: Whole-building criticism is anchored to the courtyard-centered mass and elevated attic volume.
